info.name: Ballpoint API
info.description:
Pre-built requests for the Ballpoint Marketing direct mail API. Aligned to API_KIT v1.6.12 and OpenAPI 3.1.0 (docs commit f1e713c). Import the matching environment (sandbox or production) to set base_url and partner_key.

SANDBOX MODEL: a pk_test_ key against the production host creates orders but NO real mail is printed or sent.

TIERS:
- Tier A (Safe reads and preview): read-only + preview; A1 runs cold, A2 needs a seeded order_id/campaign_id (auto-skips if unseeded). Newman smoke target: folder 'A1 - No setup required'.
- Tier B (Manual partner flows): creates data; run manually.
- Tier C (Destructive and gated - manual only): cancel/reschedule/confirm-payment/recipient edits. Never bulk-run. Tolerant tests.

Coverage is static/source-reviewed, not runtime-verified.

item.description: Creates data. Run manually; not part of the smoke subset.

request.description: Create a postcard order (billing format). Idempotency-Key is REQUIRED and a FRESH {{$guid}} is generated each send - do not reuse a stale key. Returns 202. Saves order_id to the environment.
Create a letter order (billing format). Letters REQUIRE envelope_style; postcards reject it. color_letter supports only plain_white. Returns 202.

Create an order in the partner/iframe format (PartnerOrderCreateRequest). Orders sharing a list_id are stitched into one Ballpoint campaign. Returns 200; the order id is under 'id' (not 'order_id'). Response shape is not strictly modeled - capture is tolerant.

item.name: Upload recipients - initial (replace; requires seeded order_id)

body.raw:
{
  "recipients": [
    {
      "first_name": "Jane",
      "last_name": "Doe",
      "company": null,
      "address": "100 Main St",
      "address2": null,
      "city": "San Francisco",
      "state": "CA",
      "zip": "94103",
      "contact_id": "{{contact_id}}",
      "address_type": "MAILING"
    }
  ],
  "append": false
}

request.description: Initial recipient upload for an order. PropStream flow: create the order first (with piece_count), then upload addresses here. append=false (default) REPLACES all existing recipients (idempotent re-upload); append=true APPENDS (chunked uploads). Max 10,000 recipients/request. Required per recipient: address, city, state (2-letter), zip (5 or 5+4); at least one of first_name/last_name (rows missing both are soft-rejected into rejected_details - partial acceptance). placeHolders (camelCase) carries PropStream merge tags (render personalization only, never the delivery address). Allowed order statuses: scheduled, pending_payment, accepted, prep. Distinct from Edit Leads (PATCH /recipients), which resizes piece_count + reprices on gated drops. Requires a seeded order_id in an uploadable status; tolerant test.

item.name: SSE stream connect (EventSource - not Postman native)

request.description: Server-Sent Events stream (text/event-stream). Postman does NOT render SSE natively - open connect_url (from Mint SSE token) in a browser EventSource. Auth is the query token, not X-Partner-Key. Requires a seeded sse_token. Manual only.

exec: pm.test('SSE is a text/event-stream; open connect_url in a browser', function () { return true; });

item.name: Tier C - Destructive and gated - manual only
item.description: Mutating or payment-gated. Run manually one at a time against an order you own. Excluded from any Newman run. Tolerant tests.

request.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Cancels an order. Allowed only while status is accepted or scheduled. Refund behavior depends on billing mode. Manual only - excluded from smoke runs.

STATE-CHANGE. Updates the scheduled mail date in place (same order_id). Allowed only when production_status=scheduled AND payment_confirmed=false. Recomputes scheduled_production_date from the product SLA. new_mail_date is auto-set ~45 days ahead by the collection pre-request. Manual only.

GATED, server-to-server ONLY (never from a browser - exposes the key). Gated accounts only (requires_payment_confirmation=TRUE). status:success debits the partner balance and advances pending_payment -> accepted. Set order_id and transaction_id in your environment before sending. Tolerant test. Manual only.

GATED, server-to-server only. status:failed moves the order to payment_failed (terminal); no balance debit. Replaying the opposite status returns 409. Set order_id and transaction_id in your environment before sending. Tolerant test. Manual only.

GATED. Replaces all recipients on the order, resizes piece_count, and reprices. Gated accounts only; order status must be scheduled or pending_payment and payment_confirmed=false. Does not debit. Tolerant test. Manual only.

GATED. Campaign-level delta add/remove across all editable drops (status scheduled/pending_payment, payment_confirmed=false). Locked drops are skipped and reported. Gated accounts only. Tolerant test. Manual only.
